precondition: k, n pass the function's own validation
invariant: every entry of the returned interval is finite
alarm: any entry is NaN or inf
rationale: a validated call must not return NaN/inf bounds

precondition: any call that passes the 0 <= D <= 2 check
invariant: N is nonzero before it is used as a divisor in `D < 2.0 / N`
rationale: N is not validated; the division raises ZeroDivisionError / yields inf

precondition: all data finite with |x| < 1e150 and every MAD nonzero
observation_point: after `value` is computed, before the scalar/array return
alarm: such data yields a non-finite value
rationale: finite inputs with a nonzero scale must not yield NaN/inf

precondition: any call past the scalar MAD == 0 early return
invariant: f2 is nonzero wherever MAD is nonzero
rationale: the documented MAD == 0 case is handled; a zero f2 elsewhere is an unguarded division

precondition: any call reaching the matrix quotient
invariant: denominator_matrix is nonzero for all rows/columns whose MAD is nonzero
alarm: a zero in denominator_matrix among MAD != 0 rows
rationale: only MAD == 0 rows are patched afterwards; other zeros give inf/NaN

precondition: x and y finite and non-constant (a constant variable has an undefined correlation)
invariant: the radicand bicorr[0,0]*bicorr[1,1] is strictly positive
rationale: dividing by sqrt of a non-positive radicand gives inf/NaN

precondition: weights broadcast to data.shape; slices whose weights are all zero are excluded
observation_point: immediately before the C and S quotients
alarm: sum(weights, axis) == 0 while some weight is nonzero
rationale: an all-zero (or cancelling) weight sum is an unguarded divisor

precondition: alpha and beta finite and non-constant, with ptp(alpha)*ptp(beta) > 1e-100 (a constant sample has an undefined correlation; smaller spreads underflow the sum-of-squares product, a floating-point limit)
invariant: the product of the two sums of squares is strictly positive
alarm: product of sums of squares <= 0 or NaN
rationale: constant-angle input makes the sqrt divisor zero

precondition: any call to fitness
invariant: M_k = T_k / dt is nonzero for every block
rationale: a zero block duration or dt is an unguarded divisor

precondition: return_bins is requested (the division is only evaluated there)
rationale: constant data gives sigma == 0 and divides by zero

precondition: return_bins is requested; zero IQR on non-constant data is excluded (documented ValueError, astropy #7125)
rationale: zero interquartile range divides by zero

precondition: any call
rationale: unvalidated n_params is a divisor

precondition: ssr finite (a non-finite ssr from overflowing residuals is a floating-point limit)
invariant: ssr / n_samples is nonnegative and finite (ssr == 0 is a defined limit)
rationale: log of a non-positive argument is -inf/NaN

precondition: any call (zero signal over zero noise, i.e. zero exposure, is excluded; infinite noise from overflow is a floating-point limit)
invariant: noise is nonzero and not NaN
alarm: noise == 0 with signal != 0, or noise is NaN
rationale: zero total noise divides by zero

precondition: crop=True
invariant: the returned array has the input array's shape
rationale: a shape-preserving filter must not change the array shape

precondition: finite array and finite kernel with sum|array| * sum|kernel| < 1e300, no mask and no masked-array input (a fully masked window gives NaN by documented design)
observation_point: before the dtype cast and return
alarm: such inputs give a non-finite result
rationale: finite inputs should not yield NaN/inf

precondition: any call
rationale: a non-divisible reshape raises or silently truncates

precondition: any call
rationale: constant (or single finite value) data divides by zero

precondition: any call
rationale: user-supplied n_samples is not validated

precondition: any call
alarm: baseline or samples_per_peak zero, or df non-finite/zero
rationale: a single time stamp gives zero baseline

precondition: center_data is True and every uncertainty in [1e-100, 1e100]
rationale: infinite dy gives zero or non-finite weights

precondition: any call
rationale: n_bootstraps == 0 gives an empty sample

precondition: any call
invariant: sum of ivar in and out of transit is nonzero
observation_point: immediately before the in/out weighted means
rationale: an empty in- or out-of-transit mask is an unguarded divisor

precondition: the mask m is non-empty and every uncertainty in [1e-100, 1e100]
rationale: non-empty mask can still have zero total weight

precondition: dy is not None and every uncertainty in [1e-100, 1e100]
invariant: weighted sum of ones is finite and nonzero
rationale: infinite dy zeroes all weights

precondition: any call
invariant: count of unmasked elements is nonzero
rationale: a fully masked axis gives a zero count

precondition: size has angular units
invariant: the axis pixel scale is nonzero
rationale: a degenerate WCS or supplied scale divides by zero

precondition: any call
rationale: x_0 is a free parameter with no bound

precondition: any call
rationale: amplitude is a free parameter with no bound; NaN from arcsin outside [-1, 1] is the model's mathematical domain and is not alarmed

precondition: any call
rationale: beta >= 1 divides by zero or takes sqrt of a negative

precondition: any call
rationale: at the poles the divisor is numerically zero (cos of the float nearest pi/2 is ~6e-17, never exactly 0)

precondition: any call
rationale: a matter-only flat model makes the prefactor divisor zero
